title: AS Tagging Toolkit (with monthly AS feature snapshots)
description:
Open Python toolkit to assign, retrieve, and customize tags for Autonomous Systems (ASes) from monthly AS feature snapshots — per-ASN feature tables aggregating routing, DNS, scanning, geolocation, topology, and organization-mapping signals. This archive bundles the as_tagging package (also on PyPI) together with the released monthly feature-snapshot packages. Artifact of the paper Rethinking and Facilitating How We Classify Autonomous Systems by Network Properties (ACM IMC 2026).

Toolkit code is MIT-licensed. The AS feature-snapshot data under data/ is distributed under Georgia Tech's Acceptable Use Agreement (see data/LICENSE).
